messages:
clara.design: quick design poke 20 — compact structured-output row for playground run history. figma: https://figma.redwood/s/compact-row

ravi.devex: nice. what's the copy on the collapse control?

clara.design: using 'Preview' visually, expands to 'Show full output'. aiming to keep line-height slim.

mike.product: users want quick glanceables: status, latency, error flag. can we surface those as micro-chips in the row?

ava.a11y: accessibility: visible text required for toggle, aria-expanded, aria-controls, keyboard support. chips should be text nodes (or buttons if interactive) with aria-labels.

jules.eng: impl note: collapse when tokens>160 or lines>7. stream into hidden node but render last 3 lines in preview to avoid reflow.

ravi.devex: add an ellipsis menu with 'Copy summary' and 'Open in inspector'. keyboard accessible menu.

clara.design: will tweak mocks: chips inline to the right, compact toggle left, tooltip + aria-describedby for truncated values, and single polite live region updated on toggle.

ava.a11y: ensure live region updates only on explicit user action and keep message short, e.g. 'Preview expanded: status ok, 24ms'.

mike.product: also persist per-run collapsed state in session.

jules.eng: will add unit tests for collapse heuristic and keyboard e2e for toggle/menu.

clara.design: thanks all  will post PR tomorrow for accessibility and copy review. :sparkles:
